claim_boundaries: Do not claim V3 broadly beats V2.x.
Do not claim package install or SDK readiness.
Do not claim multi-GPU or broad hardware portability.
Do not claim public Spatial speedup, RTDL-beats-RayJoin, or paper reproduction.
Do not claim true zero-copy, V4 C ABI, embedding, or multi-language host support.
Do not turn app-specific native engines into the V3 release surface.

decision_audit.decision: Record that Phoenix V3 still has a P0 major runtime-performance gap even after the scoped Claude verdict.
decision_audit.different_path_now: Keep the P0 gap machine-readable: V3 needs serious all-app runtime stress-test wins before release.
decision_audit.foolish_actions: The foolish action was letting row-scoped evidence and a scoped verdict replace broad V2.x runtime-performance proof.
decision_audit.other_path: Keep the no-remaining-P0 ledger. That would mislead the next worker and the user.
decision_audit.was_i_foolish: Yes. I previously treated scoped release authorization as if it closed the V3 major-version gap.
